verdict.rationale: Datadog has a first-party Dashboards product. Community reports say non-devs can build dashboards, widgets move between dashboards and notebooks, and URL state makes views easy to share. A standout hexagon map visualization is also praised. missing for 10: any evidence of template variables, documented coverage of the visualization/widget types, and first-party documentation of dashboard sharing.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build shareable dashboards with rich visualization types and template variables

citations.quote: widgets can be moved between dashboards and notebooks, and state lives in the URL so views are easy to share in Slack
Datadog's server hexagon map chart praised as an innovative, standout visualization.
